name: @red-cup-engineering/gcloud-cloud-run-actuator-service
description: A network-addressable actor that executes bounded Google Cloud Run operations through the installed Google Cloud SDK.

scripts.check: node --check src/gcloud-cloud-run-actuator.mjs && node --check bin/gcloud-cloud-run-actuator.mjs && node --check bin/serve.mjs

x-agentic-metro-enterprise.admission: a bounded Cloud Run operation addressed to this actor, with an authenticated bearer for deployment or invocation
x-agentic-metro-enterprise.refusal: arbitrary gcloud arguments, commands outside Cloud Run, a missing deployment image, an invalid service name, missing authority for mutation, or any persistence request
